legend.held: round-trips losslessly through our own exporter -> our own importer
legend.reshaped: the value survives but its role/shape changes (e.g. a composer relabelled a writer)
legend.dropped: the exporter writes this field but the importer never reads it back — lost on our own round trip
legend.n/a: this format's exporter never attempts to write this field at all — nothing was ever sent
